items.title: Wolfspeed Q1 FY27 revenue $155 mn; guides Q2 to $155-175 mn, gross margin near breakeven
items.text: Wolfspeed reported Q1 FY27 revenue of about $155 million (Power about $117 million, up 10% sequentially; Materials about $38 million). Non-GAAP gross margin was about -12.8%, a 710 bp sequential improvement, and Q2 revenue is guided to $155-175 million with margin approaching break-even. Management called AI data centre its fastest-growing end market and said the expanded Infineon supply deal now adds 200mm wafers. For India, it is a global read-through on SiC utilisation and pricing as RIR and L&T Semiconductor prepare to enter a market where the leading pure-play is still loss-making.

items.title: onsemi Q3 revenue $1,722.3 mn, +11% YoY; Sungrow adopts EliteSiC hybrid module
items.text: onsemi reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,722.3 million, up 11% year-over-year and 7% sequentially, with free cash flow of $489 million and AI data centre revenue up 175% year-over-year. Q4 revenue guidance is $1,715-$1,815 million. The release has no dedicated SiC section, but notes Sungrow adopted onsemi's EliteSiC hybrid power module. It is a read-across on global SiC demand from solar/storage and data-centre power; no direct impact on the Indian listed names, which are pre-revenue in SiC.

items.title: CG Power unit Axiro invests in ThinSiC to build SiC power device portfolio
items.text: CG Power and Industrial Solutions said its wholly owned subsidiary Axiro Semiconductor has invested in Thinsic to expand into next-generation silicon carbide power semiconductors; the investment amount was not disclosed. The article says this follows Axiro's August 2026 acquisition of Tosil Systems for Rs 16.44 crore (100% equity). CG Power is not on this page's company list, but it is another listed Indian group moving into SiC devices alongside RIR, L&T and Kaynes.

items.title: Wolfspeed signs multiyear SiC device supply deal with BorgWarner for 800V inverters
items.text: Wolfspeed will supply silicon carbide devices for BorgWarner's next-generation 800V SiC inverter platform, using Wolfspeed's 1200V technology and Gen 5 platform. No contract value, volumes or delivery schedule were disclosed. The release says Wolfspeed's US manufacturing has fully transitioned to 200 mm wafers. For India, it shows continued global EV-inverter design wins for incumbents, the benchmark that RIR and L&T Semiconductor must qualify against.

sources.title: Wolfspeed Powers the Future of EVs with Multiyear Silicon Carbide Device Agreement

items.title: RIR Power Q2 FY27: revenue +32.5% to Rs 33.98 cr, PAT Rs 4.45 cr; SiC start awaits approvals
items.text: RIR Power Electronics reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of Rs 33.98 crore (+32.51% YoY, +25.10% QoQ), adjusted EBITDA of Rs 5.66 crore (16.65% margin) and PAT of Rs 4.45 crore (+41.2% YoY). SiC epitaxial reactors were installed in Q2 and utilities are commissioned, but commercial production awaits remaining statutory and regulatory formalities; the CEO expects operations to begin in Q3. Phase one covers epitaxy and packaging, phase two fabrication. The SiC start-up date is the key catalyst for the pure-play.

sources.title: RIR Power Electronics Limited Announces Q2 FY27 Results

items.title: Episil says SiC capacity utilisation rebounded to ~90% from ~30% in H1 2026
items.text: DIGITIMES reports Episil chairman Rex Hsu saying overall demand has gradually recovered, with SiC capacity utilisation up from about 30% in the first half of 2026 to about 90% now, with AI demand cited as a driver. Only the lede was accessible (paywalled). It points to a demand upturn at a Taiwan foundry, though substrate price deflation remains a risk for new Indian entrants.

sources.title: AI demand drives Episil SiC V-shaped recovery as GaN and TVS capacity reaches full utilization
